description: This file defines API route handlers for 'jobs' in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for retrieving job status, associated entities, saving entity mappings, and generating/downloading report files. It interacts with database models, services, and handles request/response logic within the backend API.

classes.name: JobStatusResponse
classes.description: Response model for job status including id, status, current stage, message, and progress percentage.

classes.name: MappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for mapping override submissions, including raw value and optional taxonomy IDs.

methods.name: JobStatusResponse get_job_status(job_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session))
methods.description: Fetches the status and progress of a specific job by ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[EntitySchema]] get_job_entities(job_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session))
methods.description: Retrieves entities grouped by type associated with a specific job.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] post_job_mapping(job_id: int, payload: MappingRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session))
methods.description: Saves a mapping override for an entity associated with a specific job.

methods.name: Response get_job_report(job_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session))
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the latest report file for a job, providing a file download response.

ctags.name: get_job_entities
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_job_entities(job_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session)) -> D/

ctags.name: get_job_report
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_job_report(job_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session)) -> Res/

ctags.name: get_job_status
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_job_status(job_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session)) -> Job/

ctags.name: post_job_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^async def post_job_mapping(job_id: int, payload: MappingRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends/
ctags.signature: (job_id: int, payload: MappingRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session))

ctags.name: raw_value
ctags.pattern: /^    raw_value: str = Field(..., description="Raw entity value to map")$/
